title: Add first real OpenAI Responses workflow provider
objective: Add a native-fetch OpenAI Responses API adapter to the existing durable sequential workflow runner.
userContext: An authenticated maintainer needs to configure a server-side OpenAI connection, create text agents, run them durably, cancel pending work, and inspect persisted results later.
currentBehaviour: WF-001 provides the durable provider boundary and deterministic test adapter, but no real AI provider.
requiredBehaviour: Expose a safe OpenAI connection backed by encrypted D1 provider connection and D1 provider model configuration, validate bounded agent options, create background Responses with store=false, persist and poll Response IDs, extract only final text, and cancel through the existing durable path.
userExperience: Connections reports safe readiness and model information. Agent create/edit shows adapter-specific fields. Runs preserve exact text handoff, safe failures, replay protection, cancellation, and later inspection.
functionalRequirements: Register deterministic-test and openai-responses adapters in the production runtime.
Map masterPrompt to instructions and persisted workflow input to input without modification.
Use background=true and store=false with no provider tools.
Persist the Response ID and poll or cancel it through the existing runner.
Classify ambiguous creation as provider_start_ambiguous without automatic retry.
Keep credentials server-only and snapshots safe.
technicalConsiderations: Use platform fetch with a bounded timeout and injected fake transport tests.
Keep https://api.openai.com/v1 fixed and the model deployment-configured.
Extract output_text and textual refusal fragments in provider order without exposing reasoning or raw JSON.
Preserve WF-001 D1 schema, sequencing, retry, handoff and cancellation semantics.
outOfScope: OpenAI tools, SDKs, conversations, streaming, structured outputs or multimodal input.
Branching, loops, parallel agents, repository mutation, pull requests, CI, merge or deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAI readiness requires both the server-only API key and safe configured model.
A background Response ID is persisted and replay never creates a duplicate after persistence.
Completed text is persisted and handed to the next step byte-for-byte.
Ambiguous starts do not automatically retry and pending Responses use provider cancellation.
Existing deterministic workflow tests continue to pass and mocked tests make no live OpenAI requests.
codexGuidance: Implement only the first real text provider behind the frozen WF-001 adapter boundary. Do not add tools, repository access, provider conversations, orchestration features, deployment, merge, or live provider traffic to normal tests.
